projects.title_zh: 呼吸之间——长沙岳麓区防空洞公共空间改造
projects.title_en: Between Breaths — Adapting an Air-Raid Shelter into Public Space
projects.summary_zh: 把一段冷战遗留的防空洞改成可呼吸、可停留、可聚集的城市底层公共空间。用地形重塑、采光井、与既有结构的最小干预策略，让一段被城市记忆遗忘的负空间重新回到日常生活。
projects.summary_en: Reuses a Cold-War-era air-raid shelter as a breathable public commons underneath the city. Minimal intervention, re-grading, and skylight insertion bring a forgotten negative volume back into everyday use.

projects.summary_en: Multi-objective optimisation with Ladybug + EnergyPlus + Octopus — a Pareto front across daylight (DA/UDI), thermal comfort (PMV) and energy use, yielding a set of constructable façade retrofits.
